<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>لوحة تحكم المالك - كوميكس أوفرلاي</title>
<script src="rostrick-admin.js"></script>
<style>
:root {
  --primary: #D90429;
  --primary-dark: #8D0801;
  --accent: #FFB703;
  --highlight: #FB8500;
  --control: #2B2D42;
  --bg: #F4F5F8;
  --surface: #FFFFFF;
  --text: #161722;
  --muted: #5C6078;
  --border: #DCE0EA;
  --success: #0F9D58;
  --danger: #C9182B;
}

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

html, body {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  background-color: var(--bg);
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  min-height: 100%;
}

a {
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
}

button, input, textarea, select {
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: inherit;
}

/* Comic background accent strip */
.app-shell {
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom);
}

/* Top App Bar */
.app-bar {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 30;
  background: var(--control);
  color: #FFFFFF;
  padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top);
  border-bottom: 4px solid var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgba(22, 23, 34, 0.22);
}

.app-bar-inner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  min-height: 60px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
}

.app-bar-start {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-width: 0;
}

.icon-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-width: 44px;
  min-height: 44px;
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  color: #FFFFFF;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform 0.12s ease, background-color 0.15s ease;
  padding: 0;
}
